title: Initial dual-rail invariant
statement: For any number $n$ of input variables, start with no gates and no straight-line statements, and assign to each input vertex $k<n$ the pair consisting of the input $x_k$ and its negation. These rails satisfy the dual-rail invariant: there is one pair per vertex; all statement and rail references are valid; for every input assignment, the two rails compute the vertex value and its complement; and the number of statements is at most twice the number of gates.
